content.value: The World Tree is independent from combat levels and the Passive Tree. It has its own level, XP bar, point pool, unlocked nodes, and node choices. Its maximum level is the number of nodes supplied by the server configuration.

You begin at World level 1. XP needed for the next level is 200 + 75 x current World level + 0.5 x current World level squared, rounded down. Each World level gained awards one point. At the configured maximum level, remaining World XP is set to zero.

World nodes use the same connected-route and draft/apply workflow as Passive nodes. The server validates that each new node exists, is connected to the already unlocked or newly drafted route, has a legal choice where needed, and fits your point budget.
Press O or select the World Tree tab in the Compendium. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, hover to inspect modifiers, and apply drafted changes when satisfied.

World Tree nodes are fully server-configurable. The current bundled world_tree.json contains a large layout whose non-start nodes have no names or modifiers; on that configuration, those blank nodes provide no bonus until the server author fills them in.
